The **Ski Sword** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

This weapon is made out of the front part of a Ski-O-Matic brand alpine ski. This weapon was created and used by Appalachia's raider faction. This is the second best melee weapon in terms of raw damage, second only to the Sheepsquatch Club. Modded with metal shards it has a base damage of 58, only two shy of the club.
